items.title: Microsoft 365 Services Including Teams, Outlook and Copilot Outage Hits Users in Japan and China
items.description: Thousands of users in Japan and China faced widespread access and sign-in disruptions to Microsoft 365 and Copilot services early Thursday, stemming from a critical routing issue in the company’s infrastructure.
